rows.name: Meadows
rows.description: The starting zone: easygoing meadows with a warm, nostalgic feel. The first area players hunt and gather in, before later worlds are added.

rows.name: Whisperwood
rows.description: A misty forest north of the Meadows. Light in shafts through the fog, fireflies, and trees old enough to walk on.
